def slug(text):
    """
    Convert text to slug: lowercase ASCII letters, preserve digits, replace runs of other characters with one hyphen, and strip edge hyphens.
    """
    import re
    # Convert to lowercase
    text = text.lower()
    # Replace runs of non-alphanumeric characters with a single hyphen
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]', '-', text)
    # Strip leading and trailing hyphens
    text = text.strip('-')
    return text
